title: Holy Forever
lyrics_original: To sing the song of ages to the Lamb
And all who've gone before us,
Will sing the song of ages to the Lamb
Your name stands above them all
Your name stands above them all
Sing the song forever to the Lamb
Sing the song forever to the Lamb
We'll sing the song forever and amen
To the King of kings, Holy
Your name stands above them all
Your name stands above them all (2)
To the King of kings, Holy

bible_verses.english: One generation commends your works to another; they tell of your mighty acts.
Let them praise your great and awesome name— he is holy.
Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.

devotional.prayer_english: Heavenly Father, Your name truly stands above every throne, title, and power in this world. Thank You for inviting me to be part of the eternal song that praises Your endless holiness and grace. Today, I surrender my worries and place my trust in Your unchanging sovereignty. Teach me to walk with awe and gratitude, keeping my eyes fixed on Jesus, the Lamb who reigns forever. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: When we lift our voices in worship, we are joining a timeless song that spans across every generation. Jesus, the Lamb who was slain, reigns supreme over every title, authority, and burden we carry today. In His presence, we are reminded that our present troubles are temporary, but His kingdom and holiness endure forever. As you sing today, let your heart rest in His unmatched majesty and join the chorus of heaven with joy.
